change: Coverage aspects may ground an acquisition-scope requirement in source_metadata with an exact evidenceId, accessLevel field/value, request excerpt and accepted-answer binding.
invariants: Evidence identity must be unambiguous and present in the bound claim's citations.
Only accessLevel is permitted; its value must exactly match supplied metadata.
Request and final-answer excerpts must retain the existing literal binding checks.
Mixed metadata/content obligations still require source prose grounding.
No prior model verdict or historical run is promoted or rewritten.
limitation: This validates the audit trail, not semantic correctness of arbitrary model labels; the semantic reviewer must still distinguish acquisition scope from scientific content.
